messages.subject: Morgan Stanley Houston 2025 Summer Analyst | First Round Interview Invitation
messages.body:
Jonathan,

We would like to offer you a first round interview for the Morgan Stanley Houston Summer 2025 Analyst Internship. The team has enjoyed getting to know you and thinks you could be a great fit for this role.

If you are interested, let me know your availability for a 30 minute virtual interview this coming Monday January 29th (between 10am and 4pm) or Tuesday January 30th (between 10am and 4pm). Please send your latest resume including applicable test scores and GPA updated for the latest semester.

If you have not already completed the online application<https://morganstanley.tal.net/vx/brand-0/spa-1/candidate/so/pm/1/pl/1/opp/17261-2025-Investment-Banking-Summer-Analyst-Program-United-States/en-GB>, please do so ahead of the interview.

Looking forward to speaking soon, and let me know if you have any questions.

-Matt

Matt Manriquez, Associate
Morgan Stanley | Investment Banking Division
600 Travis Street, Suite 3700 | Houston, TX 77002
Phone: +1 713 512-6629
Mobile: +1 646 737-4926
Matt.Manriquez@morganstanley.com<mailto:Matt.Manriquez@morganstanley.com>

________________________________

Good Afternoon Matt,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing this email to extend my
gratitude for the opportunity to interview with you this morning. The
experience was not only enjoyable and informative, but also presented some
valuable challenges and great learning opportunities, for which I am very
appreciative. I look forward to hopefully continuing this process with
Morgan Stanley Houston. Thanks again!

Best,
Jonathan

On Mon, Jan 29, 2024 at 11:27 AM <Matt.Manriquez@morganstanley.com> wrote:

> Thanks Jonathan, received. Looking forward to it as well.
>
>
>
> -Matt
>
>
>

> Interview Invitation
>

> Good morning Matt,
>
>
>
> I sent a calendar invite over, and I'm getting that application in very
> shortly. I'm excited to talk tomorrow morning!
>
> Best,
>
> Jonathan
>

>
>
>
> Talk soon,
>
> Matt

> Interview Invitation
>
>
>
> Hello Matt,
>
>
>
> I appreciate you reaching out to me and offering a first round interview!
> Tuesday (1/30) is preferable for me. Here are some times that work within
> that period on Tuesday: 10 am - 11:30 am, 12:30 pm - 2:30 pm. I'll go ahead
> and submit my application online in the meantime, and I look forward to
> speaking with you soon.
>
>
>
> Best,
>
> Jonathan
>
>
>
> On Sun, Jan 28, 2024 at 3:21 PM <Matt.Manriquez@morganstanley.com> wrote:
>
> Jonathan,
>
>
>
> We would like to offer you a first round interview for the Morgan Stanley
> Houston Summer 2025 Analyst Internship. The team has enjoyed getting to
> know you and thinks you could be a great fit for this role.
>
>
>
> If you are interested, let me know your availability for a 30 minute
> virtual interview this coming Monday January 29th (between 10am and 4pm)
> or Tuesday January 30th (between 10am and 4pm). Please send your latest
> resume including applicable test scores and GPA updated for the latest
> semester.
>
>
>
> If you have not already completed the online application
> <https://morganstanley.tal.net/vx/brand-0/spa-1/candidate/so/pm/1/pl/1/opp/17261-2025-Investment-Banking-Summer-Analyst-Program-United-States/en-GB>,
> please do so ahead of the interview.
>
>
>
> Looking forward to speaking soon, and let me know if you have any
> questions.
>
>
>
> -Matt
>
>
>
>
